d:
Jab in chihnon ka aavishkar bharat men huaa, to yurop inhen ‘arbi ank’ kyon kahta hai? ye das chhote chihn puri duniya men kaise chha gae? aur shuny ne itihas ki disha kaise badal di?
Pashchimi duniya inhen ‘arbi ank’ kahti hai, jabki arab duniya men yurop men istemal hone vale ankon ke rup ko pashchimi mana jata hai. to bharat se yurop aur phir duniyabhar men pahunche in chihnon men ’arbi’ kya hai?
